retrievalProfile.description: A 90s-inspired urban character layout featuring a stylized mascot in streetwear against a textured brick wall with heavy, stacked sans-serif display type.
triggerTerms: urban mascot with sunglasses and backwards cap
bold orange stacked typography on teal brick

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, high-contrast composition featuring a cartoon character dressed in oversized urban clothing (baggy jeans, work boots, sunglasses, and a backwards cap) positioned to the right, overlapping large-scale, condensed orange-to-red gradient text set against a dark teal, textured brick wall.
coreVisualRelationships: Character overlaps the primary display text to create depth
Complementary color scheme of orange/red against teal/blue
Textured background contrasts with the smooth vector gradients of the character
Vertical stacking of text balances the verticality of the character
coreInvariants: Dark teal brick wall texture with visible mortar lines
Character wearing a backwards baseball cap and dark sunglasses
Orange-to-red vertical gradient on the main text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Character is positioned on the right third of the frame, scaled to nearly the full height of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The character's face and sunglasses serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the character's face, down to the hands, then left across the large typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the lower-left quadrant to allow the brick texture to show through.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange (primary text and character accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground elements against a desaturated, darker background for maximum pop.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are vertically stretched to fill the layout height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family weight variation with a smaller script or logo-style font in the corner.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary verticality and blocky structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark teal brick wall with a gritty texture. Place a cartoon character on the right side wearing baggy blue jeans, orange boots, a black shirt, a red backwards cap, and black sunglasses. Leave the left side open for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, condensed, uppercase sans-serif text in the upper left. Apply a vertical gradient from orange at the top to red at the bottom. Ensure the character's arm slightly overlaps the text.

verificationChecks: Is the text condensed and bold?
Does the character overlap the text?
Is the background a teal brick texture?
Is the color palette dominated by orange and teal?

mustRedesign: Ensure the character is a generic urban mascot, not a protected IP
postGenerationChecks: Verify the brick texture is consistent
Ensure the gradient on the text is smooth
Confirm the character's pose feels dynamic
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Character + Condensed Stacked Type + Textured Brick Background + Complementary Teal/Orange Palette
